summary: 跨 owner 编排执行首片 on BASE 1c2c6ca. Adds invoicing/orchestration_services.py that turns a PH-320 reversal/attribution context into named owner-service execution for management-revenue reversal, cash refund/bank return and settlement clearance/reverse-clearance. The service validates invoice/reversal/expected_version, derives a deterministic owner request token from the orchestration token, invokes the owner's named service (reverse_recognition / record_refund / record_bank_return / create_clearance / reverse_clearance), builds the resulting owner ref, and appends it through PH-320 link_invoice_orchestration after attribution validation. It stores an append-only execution receipt in AuditEvent keyed by request_token+digest (receipt is checked before state gates for replay), records executed/link_pending audit, and on owner/link failure leaves no execution receipt/link; the owner action is retried through its own idempotency receipt on retry. It never writes revenue/cash/settlement directly and explicitly returns single_transaction_claim=false. Adds a read-only orchestration snapshot and invoicing page with separate history_read page and business_write execute routes; owner/finance write, auditor read, member denied. No new canonical model/migration/canonical topic/contract schema. Tests cover real cash-refund owner execution + link + audit + snapshot, token replay/no duplicate owner fact and changed-input conflict, failed owner action with no execution/link, role/expected-version rejection, cross-org invoice and mismatched-counterparty attribution rejection, revenue/settlement dispatch via injected named-service fakes, and HTTP GET/POST/invalid/role behavior. verify_integrity has no new PH-370 branch because core verify_integrity is outside the PH-370 allowlist; the read-only snapshot is the in-scope reconciliation surface. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: execute now requires invoicing module enabled at the service layer (not just the page), and orchestration_snapshot now allows only owner/finance/auditor/pm (pm project scope preserved), denying member/unknown roles; regressions cover disabled-module execute and direct member snapshot reads.

review.reviewer: independent PH-370 cross-owner orchestration reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the orchestration service bypasses the invoicing module/read-role gates on direct service/API paths: `orchestration_services._fresh` only checks active membership and write role for execute, but does not check `is_enabled(organization, 'invoicing')`; `execute_invoice_orchestration` can therefore run the named owner services while the invoicing module is disabled. `orchestration_snapshot` uses `_fresh(write=False)`, which has no role check and only explicitly denies pm, so a member can read orchestration executions directly even though the task/view contract requires member denial. The views call `services._fresh` first, but services/API are required to enforce the same gate. Fix: gate execute on the invoicing module enabled and snapshot on the invoice READ_ROLES (owner/finance/auditor/pm with pm managed-project rules), delegate to `services._fresh` or replicate it, and add direct-service tests for module-disabled execute and member snapshot denial.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: execute validates invoice/reversal/expected_version, action mapping and payload, derives an owner token for retry idempotency, calls only the named owner services (revenue reverse, cash refund/bank return, settlement clearance/reverse), records the PH-320 reference link plus an append-only AuditEvent receipt, and returns single_transaction_claim=false with a read-only snapshot; the cash-refund owner action is exercised end-to-end; no new canonical model/migration/topic/contract schema and no direct owner-model writes; pages/domain metadata/routes/templates are wired; no verifier branch is disclosed; 14 files within the PH-370 whitelist; check 295; makemigrations clean; scoped tests 8 OK; full 1293/5F+3E/70 known baseline; verify-change only review gate, no path_out_of_scope.

The service does not claim a global single transaction; owner actions and link recording share the request's DB transaction but owner services remain the sole owner writers.
No PDF/email/portal, multi-currency extension, batch execution, or direct revenue/cash/settlement writes were added; no PG concurrency claim.
